gates.rule: Official Planning Data entity/search discovery exists
Promotion requires direct entity readback; one safe retry maximum
Positive structured residential capacity required for promotion
Notes, capacity, permission and source version must agree
Official source location/point captured; point is not canonical parcel polygon
Only all-gate direct-readback rows can be promoted

rendering_contract.state_derivation: ELIGIBLE => seven PASS; DIRECT_FAIL => discovery PASS, direct FAIL, downstream CLOSED; DIRECT_PASS excluded => discovery/direct PASS, exclusion-related quality gate FAIL, remaining downstream CLOSED; SEARCH_ONLY excluded => discovery PASS, direct CLOSED, promotion CLOSED
